compass: Real-VIX unified tri-scope conditional scenario generator
hypothesis: 734a/739a remains the protected deployable incumbent; 766a shows the 755a short-prefix ingredient can be run as a frozen tri-scope framework, but it is not promotable until sticky OAS factor delta-KS and native joint IV level support are repaired without changing the shared generative core.
prediction_L3: A promotable candidate must improve IV coverage/level allocation without losing mean reversion or economic-link realism, preserve anchor-only and native joint panel realism/co-movement, and pass tri-scope non-regression. IV-only wins remain diagnostic unless the same recipe transfers to anchor-only and native joint.
kill_gate: Reject deployable promotion if IV mean reversion regresses, IV scenario realism regresses, anchor/joint realism regresses, or the run only works by changing loss weights, backend, sampler, calibration layer, or stochastic source across scopes. Old conditionality is replaced by risk-state allocation when it passes. Old IV-EWMA cointegration is kept as monitoring. The additive iv_ewma_economic_link diagnostic is the IV/EWMA economic-link gate when present, but it is not cointegration.
warm_start: 734a/739a deployable tri-scope incumbent plus 766a short-prefix tri-scope transfer and 755a IV-only frontier reference
baseline: deployable incumbent: 734a/739a; active research base: 766a short-prefix tri-scope transfer; IV frontier reference: 755a; rejected diagnostic branch: 765a
